nom: Hero Cosmetics Mighty Patch Chin Acne Pimple Patches

avis.texte: This really helped woth acne I have been having on my chin. I sturggled a little to peel it off correctly at first but other than that it is a great product.

avis.titre: I would def buy this again!
avis.texte: great product. cleared up my chin acne very well! I love this brand including all of there products. when I wear this product to bed I can't feel the patch, it is very un-noticeable. I would recommend this product to everyone!

I normally love Mighty Patch's standard pimple patches, so I thought these would be effective for the cluster of white heads on my chin that never seem to go away. Turns out, not so much. Took three different strips to finally get a successful application without the strip folding in and sticking on itself (which is a huge bummer when there's already not that many strips in the package, especially considering the price). Followed the directions as stated on the package, kept it on for twelve hours, and the next morning, nothing on the patch, and the whiteheads were still there. But I did get a lovely irritation burn to deal with for the few days. 🙄 So, sensitive skin friends, beware. All-in-all, save your money, save your skin, and just get hydrocolloid bandages from the pharmacy if you need a larger surface area covered than a typical pimple patch.

While they do help surface pimples and clear out some gunk, I'm often left feeling that I still have stuff left inside, which another pimple patch (from another brand) will confirm. All in all, while these work and will remove stuff, other brands are better, but YMMV.

avis.titre: Left a burn on my chin
avis.texte: Had a couple pimples on my chin, put this on at 11pm- took it off by 7am and when I removed it, it removed a layer of my skin. It looks like a chemical burn. I do not recommend for people who have sensitive skin. Picture was first day, looks worse now

very expensive for what you get. i would not say they work better than other competitors on here. i found they dry my skin out, but do allow acne to surface to clear breakouts faster. they're very hard to get off the packaging and it will curl on the corner if you try to get it off

avis.titre: AMAZING, i just wish they were bigger
avis.texte: Cleared up most of my cystic acne, I just wish they were bigger to cover more area!
Nothing has given me better results than this product. I have repurchased time and time again and recommend to everyone I know.
These work really nicely with my acne. They actually help the white head come to the surface unlike other brands.

I was beyond ecstatic when these came out. I break out the most on my chin so these are very efficient for tackling acne on my face. The contoured design and the slits allow the patch to lay very nicely on your chin, and it stays STUCK stuck. I do wish it was ever so slightly larger, but it's size does overall offer great coverage.

The chin patch did absolutely nothing to remove anything of the mess that my chin has, and along with that, it just added some wrinkles to it, too. It's safe to say that it did basically nothing. I left it on overnight (11-7) and when I woke up, I went to remove it and discovered that it did literally nothing. I'd rather just pick the pimples off than use this again.

I am 34 with a few health issues and tons of medications. I grew up in California but moved to Mississippi in the last decade. I never had acne or any hormonal issues up until I hit 25. I break out so badly out here especially since I moved and had a baby. I break out on my cheeks, t zone, hairline and chin/jaw. These patches are so nice to wear over night or if I'm staying at home. I get very deep but small clogged pores that get inflamed and seem to last forever. These patches help speed up the healing time by alot! I can't go without any type of pimple patch in my routine now!

Love this patch! My skin has always been sensitive around my chin and is one of the first areas to break out. These patches help prevent breakouts and keep the area less congested. Will be buying more!

avis.titre: Great product, make sure your remove with time to spare
avis.texte: I love using these patches to get rid of excess oils and help reduce my acne. 4 stars because these do leave marks on your skin that take a while to go away (think bra indentions). Once they do however, your skin is left feeling less oily and less inflamed.

I always tend to get pimple clusters or blackheads on my chin. These Mighty Patch For Chin Patches have really helped clear my skin! I put one on before bd, then upon awakening, I simply tear it off and see all the gunk that it has soaked up overnight! Very pleasing! It clears my chin right up every time! I love them!

Amazing! I use a lot of Hero patches and the chin patch is a definite winner. I especially like the "tabs" they put on the peel off plastic piece that makes it super easy to peel off the patch when putting it on. Suggestion…put these tabs on the nose patches please!
These helped me so much getting all the oily gunk from my chin and help prevent breakouts. It's amazing how you can actually see all the gunk when you peel off.

Man sometimes I develop multiple pimples on my chin and what better way to tackle them than with this patch. I love how big it is, how flexible it feels, how gentle it's on my face, and its grip. Obviously this patch is a bit noticeable so I don't wear this out :grimacing: It contains hydrocolloid which is a gel that absorbs gunk!
My footballer was getting terrible breakouts from his chin strap. We grabbed these and they work great! overnight did the trick.
It is a big for my chin but I like how it covers the whole area. The effect is guaranteed!
So much easier than what I used to do, piling a bunch of the smaller ones on my chin.
wow. they're perfect!! i'll never purchase any other patches :)

Mighty Patch products are phenomenal. I am currently using them for my 20 year old disabled daughter, who requires full care. I wish Mighty Patch was available back in the eighties! These products are a game changer. Including a photo of this morning's dirty chin patch. Thanks for the daily rescue, Mighty Patch! We appreciate you.
Removes a remarkable amount of gunk from my chin. Will purchase again
Removed so much gunk i didn't realize it was that bad. Wish i could show pictures so you could see all of the gunk on the patch. Very satisfying pull.

I bought three different kinds and I'm irritated I can't get my money back. Not sure if all these great reviews are being paid for to say they work but they absolutely don't. Very unfortunate.

Thanks to Hero Skin Squad, I was gifted this Hero Cosmetics Mighty Patch Chin in exchange for my honest review. I'm in love with Hero Cosmetics' Mighty Patch Chin. As if their individual pimple patches weren't amazing enough, Mighty Patch Chin is designed to clear clusters of blemishes and pimples with just one easy to apply patch. If your skin is anything like mine, you constantly get those hideous, yet easily squeezable white heads that just ooze out the second any pressure is applied. Yeah, well until using Mighty Patch Chin, I used to wonder if those little pimple nuisances would ever chill out. The answer is yes. With the Mighty Patch Chin I can eliminate those pimple pests in as little as 6 hours with very little effort. I just apply the chin patch, day or night, and while it's working magic, I don't have to worry about it bubbling up, falling off, or even being seen really, as it's designed to contour to the shape of my chin. I'm confident to talk and move as much as I wish. Its super self satisfying as it even turns white when the process and the gunk sucking is complete. This may be my favorite Hero product to date!

I no longer have to use several small patches, I can just apply one perfectly sized and shaped Chin Mighty Patch and go to sleep with the confidence my pimples will either be completely gone or greatly improved when I wake up. I 10 out of 10 recommend. "I received this product for free for the purpose of my review. All opinions are my own."
